profile.name: Phillip Raich
profile.title: Computer Engineer
profile.about: Computer engineer and software engineer with enterprise Java and Angular experience at General Motors, with a strong focus on quality, security, cloud deployment, and measurable reliability.

highlights: Engineered and maintained five enterprise applications using Java backends and Angular frontends, utilized by thousands of users for critical request-to-pay processes.
Implemented comprehensive unit testing suites to achieve 95% or higher coverage. Instrumented Datadog for application metrics, achieving 100% yearly uptime over three years.
Created daily builds and scanning workflows to proactively identify security flaws. Regularly patched dependencies and refactored code to meet strict enterprise security standards.
Implemented SAP integrations through OData and Redis caching, improving application load times by 55%.
Deployed and managed containerized workloads across Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, and Azure.
Developed automated GitHub Actions workflows for blue/green deployments with active/active regional redundancy for disaster recovery.
Experienced with AI tools such as Copilot, Glean, and Cursor to increase engineering throughput and PR turnaround.
Identified root causes of engine performance issues, warning lights, transmission concerns, suspension failures, and electrical malfunctions.
Performed repairs and component replacements on engines, brake systems, steering and suspension, HVAC, fuel systems, and electrical wiring to meet manufacturer specifications and safety standards.
Managed daily store operations in the absence of management, including opening and closing procedures, cash handling, and shift supervision.
